name: cost-guard
description: Spending guardrails for Claude Code: session, daily and monthly caps, Pro/Max 5-hour and weekly limit warnings with pace, a runaway-spend breaker, a warning before resuming an idle session, context advice, and tips (with one-step, undoable fixes) for plugins, skills, MCP servers and CLAUDE.md files that burn tokens. No admin rights needed.

session_cap_usd.title: Session cap (USD)
session_cap_usd.description: Hard stop for one session: new prompts are blocked and tool calls are denied.

daily_cap_usd.title: Daily cap (USD)
daily_cap_usd.description: Hard stop for all sessions on this machine in one calendar day.

monthly_cap_usd.title: Monthly budget (USD)
monthly_cap_usd.description: All sessions on this machine in one calendar month. By default you get a daily warning past it; turn on the hard stop below to block instead.

monthly_hard_stop.title: Stop at the monthly budget
monthly_hard_stop.description: Block new prompts and tool calls past the monthly budget (otherwise: warn once a day).

warn_at_pct.title: Warn at % of a cap
warn_at_pct.description: One-time warning when the session, day or month reaches this share of its cap, with the pace at which it will be hit.

burst_usd_per_15min.title: Runaway breaker (USD per 15 min)
burst_usd_per_15min.description: If one session spends more than this within 15 minutes (usually a loop or a huge context), the next tool call is paused once. 0 turns it off.

desktop_notify.title: Desktop notifications
desktop_notify.description: Show a desktop notification when cost-guard stops a session or a cap warning fires, so you see it while away.

warn_at_usd.title: Alert at (USD)
warn_at_usd.description: Comma-separated session amounts that show a one-time alert without blocking, for example 10,25,50.

cold_cache_warn_usd.title: Cold-cache warning (USD)
cold_cache_warn_usd.description: Stop once when resuming an idle session would cost more than this just to re-cache its context.

override_word.title: Override word
override_word.description: Put this word in a message to continue past a stop.

context_warn_k.title: Context advice at (k tokens)
context_warn_k.description: When the context passes this many thousand tokens, show once what fills it and how to shrink it.

insights_every_days.title: Cost tips every (days)
insights_every_days.description: At session start, show the top 3 ways to cut cost found in your last 14 days (unused plugins, skills, MCP servers, chatty hooks). 0 turns this off.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: auto: detect a Pro/Max/Ultra plan (warns on the 5-hour and weekly limits; dollar caps never block), a company gateway (its spend limit), or a pay-per-token API key. Set it to force one.
